source: Reference values copied from temp/benchmark.txt; default benchmark uses fixture data to validate DQMC-to-ED normalization semantics.

normalization.ed_total_NE: ED script accumulates NE = NE_b + NE_c.
normalization.dqmc_total_NE: DQMC total particle number is num_up + num_do.
normalization.ed_total_kinetic: ED kinetic operator includes both b and c hopping layers.
normalization.dqmc_kinetic: DQMC file kinetic includes both flavors and is divided by Lq, so compare kinetic * Lq.
